detail.readme:
Snapshot

Snapshot is an off-chain gasless multi-governance client with easy to verify and hard to contest results.


snapshot.org »

Documentation • Feature requests • Contribute
## Project setup ``` yarn ``` ### Compiles and hot-reloads for development ``` yarn dev ``` ### Compiles and minifies for production ``` yarn build ``` ### Lints and fixes files ``` yarn run lint ``` ### Development Guide Use `http://localhost:8080/#/fabien.eth` for testing your code. By default your instance will connect to the hub at `https://testnet.hub.snapshot.org`. To change that (or other values) you can create a `.env.local` and overwrite the values from `.env`. ## Running service locally with Docker 1. Run `docker build -t snapshot .` to build the image 2. Run `docker run --name snapshot -p 8080:8080 snapshot` to run the container 3. Go to `http://localhost:8080/#/fabien.eth` to test your code ## Sponsors [XAUS](https://xaus.com) ## License Snapshot is open-sourced software licensed under the © [MIT license](LICENSE).
